description: Sixth lane generation (#671 C9): PrecisionMemBench retrieval under the frozen AMB harness at the declared transition to Runtime Baseline v5 (ranking policy 3.3.0), with control-row cross-fact causal attribution through bridge 0.4.0.
freeze_rationale: Runtime Baseline v5 changes ranking policy 3.2.0 to 3.3.0 by adding guarded explicit-current cross-fact applicability, requiring a new same-harness lane rather than copied evidence
every non-blank agent-memory case is joined to bridge-0.4.0 cross-fact evidence; any output change from accepted v4 must be attributed and its mechanism-off replay must reproduce v4
BM25 and Mem0 are re-executed; the v4 shadow row is deferred to T-controller-2; the semantic row remains deferred under the unchanged AMB uv.lock incompatibility

harness.license_note: no LICENSE file exists at the frozen revision and neither README nor pyproject declares one; the harness is executed from an external checkout and is never redistributed by this repository

dataset.input_digest_rule: sha256 over the raw bytes of beliefs.seed.json followed by retrieval.cases.json; each fixture file is also digest-bound individually and the run refuses on any mismatch before ingestion
notes: 34 beliefs belong to test-user and 1 to other-user; the cross-user case is a leak fixture, so per-user scoping is part of the measured behaviour
document content is upstream beliefToText(): canonical_name + aliases + content + why_it_matters, byte-identical for every provider
13 query categories; categories partition queries, not documents

selection.selection_method: full single-turn case set in fixture order; no --query-limit, --category, --query-id, --unit, --oracle, --doc-limit

budget.retrieval_k_rule: k passed to the provider is the case's maxBeliefs budget (case.budget.maxBeliefs, default 20); the Agent Memory control declares that k as the facade return budget (contract 1.4.0) and returns the facade's `returned` prefix; the scorer then keeps the top maxBeliefs distinct resolved beliefs after excluding pinned facts
forbidden_overrides: no provider may read case metadata, gold ids, or expect blocks

gold_identity.rule: per case: expect.relevantBeliefs.shouldOnlyInclude or mustInclude plus pinnedFacts.mustInclude; mustExclude, maxCount/minCount, orderedBefore, openQuestions and personaPrelude assertions are scored by the frozen harness exactly as upstream
gold_identity.leakage_rule: providers receive Document(id, content, user_id, timestamp, context, tags) only; the context field carries beliefId= for the resolver's marker path exactly as the frozen harness supplies it to every provider; queries, gold ids, budgets and expect blocks never reach ingestion; each result records which resolution path fired

evaluator.integrity_check: scripts/precisionmembench_selfcheck.py at the frozen revision: a perfect provider must reproduce 43/43 active, 77/77 total, precision/recall 1.00; run before any contestant

execution.timeout: none in the frozen harness; the workflow job timeout (180 min) bounds the run
execution.failure_handling: the frozen runner retries a query up to 4 times only on transient-provider error codes (502/503/529/429/overloaded/quota); any other exception aborts the run, which is recorded as blocked/failed execution, never as a score

environment.harness_install: pip install -e <frozen AMB checkout> under pip constraints exported from the checkout's own uv.lock (scripts/amb_harness_constraints.py); the lock blob, the uv release, and every lifted pin are recorded in the execution identity
environment.placeholder_gemini_key: the frozen CLI constructs its configured answer client before selecting retrieval mode; an inert GEMINI_API_KEY value is supplied solely for construction and can never produce a result
environment.network: fixture download from the pinned upstream commit and embedder weights from the pinned Hugging Face revision; no API calls

departures: packages pinned by this repository's pyproject.toml (cryptography, jsonschema, rfc8785) follow the repository, not the lock

the mem0-explicit row replaces the lock's mem0ai 1.0.5 with mem0ai==2.2.1, which requires posthog>=7.14.0 and therefore lifts the lock's posthog 7.9.10 (telemetry client, MEM0_TELEMETRY=false); every other locked pin stays in force for every row

the mem0-explicit row removes fastembed 0.6.0 after the constrained install: the lock carries it only via cognee (a provider that row never loads) and Mem0 2.2.1 lazily enables BM25 hybrid retrieval whenever fastembed imports, which the frozen base-package row forbids; the removal is recorded in the execution identity

artifact_requirements: AMB raw EvalSummary JSON per provider (outputs/precisionmembench/<run>/retrieval/single-turn.json) with per-case meta: pass_type, active_pass, relevant_beliefs, retrieval_precision, retrieval_recall, resolution, failures
execution identity JSON: repository revision, AMB revision, provider key, resolved dependency versions, embedder revision, fixture digests, workflow run id
agent-memory only: cross-fact.jsonl, written by bridge 0.4.0, with exactly one record per non-blank retrieve call and no blank-query record
execution_identity_requirements: exact AMB revision equal to harness.revision
per-provider resolved package versions (mem0ai, qdrant-client, sentence-transformers, torch, rank-bm25)
embedder model revision equal to the frozen Hugging Face revision
Mem0 optional-component posture (fastembed, spacy) equal to the frozen base-package install
harness lock identity (uv.lock blob and sha256) and the complete list of lifted pins, each with its reason
bridge_blobs == harness.source_blobs for every reference/* path (the Agent Memory and Mem0 AMB bridges)
lane_digest_sha256 at execution == the digest of this file as committed
runtime_baseline_state in {PASS, TRANSITION} and declaration_blob == the control row's configuration.runtime_baseline_posture.declaration_blob
no agent_memory_semantic run is importable under this lane: the row is deferred (uv.lock conflict with the pinned semantic numerics)

the agent-memory row's artifact carries cross-fact.jsonl with exactly one joined record per non-blank-query case and none for a blank-query case; every other row's artifact carries neither cross-fact.jsonl nor recall-control.jsonl

systems.display_name: Agent Memory (public facade, declared transition to Runtime Baseline v5)

source.identity: MythologIQ-Labs-LLC/agent-memory reference runtime through the public AgentMemory facade
source.revision_rule: git rev-parse HEAD of the executing checkout; the protected runtime surface is pinned by scripts/check_runtime_baseline_equivalence.py, which must print PASS or TRANSITION against the declaration blob this row pins (configuration.runtime_baseline_posture) for the run to be importable; the state, line and declaration blob are recorded in the execution identity

adapter.revision_rule: git blob of the module at execution must equal harness.source_blobs[reference/amb_agent_memory_bridge.py] = f64ee4de7b88a9da24c2a975636fd5c70fe61a12; bridge_version 0.4.0 recorded in raw responses

configuration.scope: one Agent Memory scope per AMB user_id (sha256-derived)
configuration.memory_id: deterministic logical id per (user_id, document id)
configuration.observed_at: document timestamp passed as caller-declared observed_at
configuration.query_timestamp: recorded, never used as memory authority
configuration.recall: memory.recall(query, budget=k) where k is the case's maxBeliefs budget; `returned` is the facade's ranked-prefix policy (contract 1.4.0); admitted stays whole and is counted; returned facts mapped back to AMB document ids through a revision-bound sidecar
configuration.k: the facade's return budget, never a bridge-side cap: the bridge returns the mapped documents among the top-k returned facts, so a response holds fewer than k documents when an unmapped id sits in the prefix (v1 skipped unmapped ids before counting to k); a case budget below 1 is refused

notes: concurrency 1 until multi-handle semantics are independently qualified

configuration.recall_control_telemetry: per question (LongMemEval rows) or per non-blank case (AMB sidecar recall-control.jsonl): the facade's recall_control block without usage.elapsed_ms (response.decision_status, usage.fallback_events, usage.controller_decisions_used, actual_stop.actual_stop_reason/stop_class, routes_executed, route_candidate_counts, shadow_delta, authority_effect); reported, never benchmark authority (plan-644-lanes-v4 L2)

notes: measured shadow recall-control row (#644 S9); not the v4 publication control; evidence for T-controller-2
systems.status_reason: measured at -v4 (jh-14 shipped); the next controller measurement belongs to T-controller-2's lanes

configuration.ranking: rank-bm25 BM25Okapi over lowercase whitespace tokens
configuration.user_scoping: chunks filtered by user_id before ranking when any exist

dependency_pins: rank-bm25 as resolved by the frozen AMB dependency set, recorded at execution
notes: a baseline comparator, not a market-position claim

source.revision_rule: release tag v2.2.1; pip pin mem0ai==2.2.1; mem0.__version__ verified before the provider is prepared

adapter.revision_rule: git blob of the module at the executing revision; bridge_version 0.1.0 recorded in raw responses; git blob of the module at execution must equal harness.source_blobs[reference/amb_mem0_explicit_bridge.py] = ce41b1f5766b99cb968b798be3ad6d37c3283228

configuration.inference: infer=False on every add; the constructed LLM is replaced by a fail-closed guard, so any inference call aborts the run
configuration.llm_config: provider openai with an inert api_key used solely to satisfy Mem0's eager client construction; never a credential

vector_store.mode: local path, on_disk=true, fresh per run

configuration.add: Memory.add([{'role': 'user', 'content': document.content}], user_id=<AMB user_id>, metadata={'doc_id': <document id>, 'source_timestamp': <timestamp>}, infer=False); a result without an ADD event aborts the run
configuration.search: Memory.search(query, top_k=<case k>, filters={'user_id': <AMB user_id>}); threshold 0.1 and rerank=false are Mem0 2.2.1 defaults, recorded not tuned
configuration.identity_mapping: metadata.doc_id returned as Document.id and Document.source_ids so the scorer resolves through the source_id path; results without doc_id are counted as unmapped
configuration.content_rule: document.content verbatim; structured messages, timestamps and tags are not supplied to Mem0's memory text

optional_components.install: pip install mem0ai==2.2.1 (base package, no extras); product-default posture
optional_components.fastembed_bm25_keyword_search: not installed: hybrid keyword scoring disabled, vector similarity only (Mem0 logs the condition at construction)

notes: Mem0's own hybrid vector+keyword ranking, threshold, and entity boosts are product behaviour and are not altered
no benchmark-specific prompt, mission, or dataset-name branch exists in the adapter
optional components (fastembed keyword search, spaCy lemmatizer) are absent by product default; a row with extras installed is a different frozen row, never an in-place change

systems.status_reason: deferred at freeze (plan-669-lanes-v3 D3): the AMB harness installs under its own uv.lock constraints (onnxruntime 1.22.1, tokenizers 0.22.2, numpy 2.4.3, protobuf 5.29.6, packaging 24.2), which conflict with the pinned semantic extra (reference/requirements-semantic.txt) whose versions the representation config_digest binds; the semantic route is measured on LongMemEval only (longmemeval-s-retrieval-parity-v3)

source.identity: MythologIQ-Labs-LLC/agent-memory reference runtime through the public AgentMemory facade with semantic_retrieval=required
source.revision_rule: exact repository revision at execution, once a lock-compatible semantic install exists

adapter.module: reference/amb_agent_memory_bridge.py (a semantic-mode bridge is not written)
adapter.revision_rule: git blob of the module at execution

systems.status_reason: AMB's frozen Hindsight provider installs a PrecisionMemBench-specific retain mission and floats package versions; a benchmark-agnostic, exactly pinned provider configuration must be frozen before this row can run (#640 ruling 2026-10-03)

adapter.revision_rule: to be replaced by a repository-owned benchmark-agnostic bridge

not_comparable_to: amb-precisionmembench-retrieval-v4 rows for the same system: ranking policy 3.3.0 intentionally adds guarded cross-fact currentness and bridge 0.4.0 adds attribution evidence; any output difference must satisfy the pre-registered causal attribution rule and mechanism-off replay
Agent Memory LongMemEval recall_all@k (different benchmark, different gold semantics)
AMB RAG/agent accuracy on any dataset (end-to-end answer quality, model-judged)
a future reflective Mem0 lane (different system composition)
notes: active_passes/active_total is the number comparable to upstream's Active passes column; total passes include structural and trivially-empty cases that a provider returning nothing can satisfy
BM25 is a baseline, Agent Memory is the control; neither row is a market claim
each accepted row must retain the raw AMB artifact and its execution identity; no overall score is produced

the Agent Memory control is causally compared to accepted v4: an unchanged non-blank case is EQUAL; a changed case is accepted only when cross_fact.limited_count > 0 and the mechanism-off document order renders to v4; any other difference blocks publication
the v4 shadow row is not copied forward; T-controller-2 owns the next controller measurement

deferred_lanes.reason: Mem0 reflective extraction through a frozen LLM identity is a Mem0+LLM composition; it needs provider-dependent credentials and a separately frozen answer-model identity, and must be frozen before any reflective score is seen

findings: AMB's frozen mem0 provider calls Memory.search(query, user_id=..., limit=...); Mem0 2.2.1 rejects top-level entity parameters and requires filters={'user_id': ...} with top_k=, so that provider cannot execute at the #640 pin
vectorize-io/agent-memory-benchmark carries no LICENSE file at the frozen revision; the harness is used from an external checkout only
Mem0 2.2.1 constructs its LLM client eagerly even when infer=False is used for every add; the lane satisfies construction with an inert key and guards every LLM call

Mem0 2.2.1 changes retrieval behaviour depending on optional extras (fastembed keyword search, spaCy lemmatizer); the lane freezes the base-package install and records the absent components in the execution identity

the frozen harness's pyproject dependency set does not resolve under pip's default backtracking budget (resolution-too-deep after ~26 minutes in workflow run 37343360127, before any query ran); the uv.lock shipped at the frozen revision resolves in seconds and is the harness environment the lane installs

the frozen harness lock installs fastembed 0.6.0 for its Cognee provider; run 37349426994 showed Mem0 2.2.1 would therefore have executed with hybrid BM25 retrieval, contradicting the frozen base-package row, so the row removes fastembed after install and the posture check refuses to run otherwise

the control executes during a declared baseline transition: the workflow records the checker state, line and declaration blob and the lane digest, and the importer refuses a run whose state is not admitted by the posture, whose declaration blob differs from the one pinned here, or whose bridge blobs differ from harness.source_blobs
change_rule: any change to harness revision, fixtures, selection, budget, gold identity, evaluator, execution semantics, or a frozen row's source/adapter/configuration after a score has been observed requires a new lane_id; this record is never edited in place once status leaves frozen
